question_text: To qualify for the DILG Seal of Good Local Governance, an LGU must meet all of the following conditions: (1) It must have a full-disclosure policy on its website; (2) It must have no adverse COA audit opinion for the past two years; (3) It must have a functioning local peace and order council; and (4) It must have passed the anti-red tape compliance audit. Which of the following LGUs qualifies?

options.text: LGU A: Has full-disclosure policy, has adverse COA opinion in one of the past two years, has functioning peace council, passed anti-red tape audit.
LGU B: Has full-disclosure policy, no adverse COA opinion, has functioning peace council, but failed anti-red tape audit.
LGU C: Has full-disclosure policy, no adverse COA opinion, no functioning peace council, passed anti-red tape audit.
LGU D: Has full-disclosure policy, no adverse COA opinion, has functioning peace council, passed anti-red tape audit.
